dct_description_sm: To track inland lake and river ice phenology trends and patterns in response to climate variability (ice is a good proxy indicator for climate change), to better inform the prediction and management of the impacts of climate changes on natural systems and people. This program was initiated in October 2001 to continue the Meteorological Service of Canada's volunteer weather observers ice observations. MSC had a large Database and these records form an historic baseline of observations for ice cover for Canadian Water bodies.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environment surveillance
